research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Vir Biotechnology is focused on developing antibodies and antigen-binding fragments targeting infectious diseases. Their research includes antibodies that bind to S proteins of sarbecoviruses, potentially neutralizing multiple infections, and engineered antibodies against SARS-CoV-2. They are also exploring combination therapies for influenza and hepatitis B virus, utilizing antibodies and siRNA. Additionally, they are investigating recombinant vectors for delivering antigens and immunogenic compositions for tuberculosis and cytomegalovirus. These efforts highlight their commitment to addressing viral infections through innovative immunological approaches.

overview_description.description:
Vir Biotechnology leverages the immense potential of the immune system to address critical unmet medical needs and improve patient outcomes
Our pipeline is built on two technology platforms which enable us to rapidly identify, optimize and advance candidates from concepts to the clinic: our next-generation antibody platform and the PRO-XTEN™ protease-releasable masking technology in infectious diseases and cancer, respectively.

We focus on the therapeutic areas in which we believe we can most benefit patients. Our foundational efforts in infectious diseases, with a leading program in chronic hepatitis delta, are complemented by strategic programs in oncology. We have broken ground in immunology, demonstrating our ability to discover, engineer and develop antibody-based medicines for two of the greatest health challenges of our time: COVID-19 and Ebola.

Every day, we work with the utmost urgency to deliver potentially transformative medicines for patients.
